package.author: Qianqian Fang
package.description: Monte Carlo eXtreme (MCX) - Physically accurate and validated GPU ray-tracer

en-US.author: Qianqian Fang
en-US.description: Monte Carlo eXtreme (MCX) - Physically accurate and validated GPU ray-tracer
en-US.longDescription: Monte Carlo eXtreme (MCX) is a Monte Carlo photon simulator for modeling light transport in 3D turbid media. This package installs the MCX suite - MCX (CUDA), MCX-CL (OpenCL, for NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and Apple GPUs and CPUs), MMC (mesh-based, CPU/OpenCL/CUDA/OptiX), their MATLAB/Octave toolboxes, Redbird, Iso2Mesh and the MCX Studio graphical interface.
en-US.name: MCX Studio
en-US.releaseNotes:
MCX/MCX-CL/MMC v2026 (3.0) - a milestone release
- [Feature] adjoint and frequency-domain (RF) forward simulations and Jacobians in MCX, MCX-CL and MMC
- [Feature] AMD GPU support in MCX through ROCm/HIP
- [Feature] MCX Studio 2, a new graphical interface with a built-in 3-D viewer
- [Feature] implicit MMC on OpenCL and CUDA, all source types in the OptiX-based RT-MMC
- [Feature] exact fixed-point output sums (make fixed), -F bnii binary JSON output
- [Feature] a fixed seed now simulates the same photons on every OS
- [Feature] Redbird and Iso2Mesh bundled with the MATLAB toolboxes
- [Bug fix] long-standing OpenCL GPU memory leak, replay normalization, and many fixes found by unit tests and fuzzing
